intro: Steam Community Market prices in your chosen currency. Prices refresh in the background; the app waits if Steam rate-limits requests.
tipInventoryStale: Use when Inventory value columns show dashes or prices look stale.
tipCurrencySync: Change currency here or in Settings — both stay in sync.
tipForceFull: Force full refresh re-prices everything, ignoring the 24-hour cache.
tipAutoScan: Disable auto-scan when Steam is rate-limiting — explicit refreshes still work.
emptyHint: No prices cached yet. Open Inventory while the game is running, or refresh here once you own tradable materials or Legendary+ gear.
noPriceableItems: No priceable items in inventory yet
refreshFailed: Refresh failed — check your connection and try again.
lookupDescription: Prices on the Lookup tab are separate from the Inventory values above. They come from a shared snapshot rebuilt about every 6 hours, fetched in USD and converted to your currency — so they can differ slightly from the live Steam price. Inventory values here use the prices you refresh above for the items you own.

progress.banner: Updating Steam prices in the background
progress.label: {{done}}/{{total}} — priced {{priced}}, failed {{failed}} — {{current}}

refreshMessage.queued: A refresh is already running — yours is queued.
refreshMessage.noInventory: No inventory loaded yet — play with the game running or check your save path.
refreshMessage.noop: All {{count}} items are up to date (updated within 24h). Nothing to fetch.
refreshMessage.noopOne: All 1 item is up to date (updated within 24h). Nothing to fetch.
